description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking The Fantastic Four.
When The Fantastic Four enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
